conventions: oak_door item used via ItemStack.useOn(UseOnContext(fake ServerPlayer, MAIN_HAND, BlockHitResult(hit, UP, floor pos, false))) on the top face of a stone floor at y=P.y-1, P=(96,150,96); lower half goes in P, upper in P+up. Player stands 2 blocks behind P opposite to facing, yaw = facing (0=south,90=west,180=north,270=east), pitch 45 (down). click = lateral hit coordinate offset within P's block: x for north/south facing, z for east/west facing; the other coordinate is +0.5. left = Direction.getCounterClockWise() of facing (facing south -> left=east +X; north -> left=west -X; east -> left=north -Z; west -> left=south +Z), right = clockwise. left_lower=P+left, left_upper=P+left+up, right_lower=P+right, right_upper=P+right+up. Solid cells are block ids (slab = type bottom), door cells are full state strings (as set, read back and verified; setBlock flags UPDATE_CLIENTS|UPDATE_KNOWN_SHAPE, no neighbour updates). Part A: 6^4 solids per facing/click; Part B: 8x8 door options per side (none, oak f hinge=left, oak f hinge=right, spruce f left, oak opposite(f) left, iron f left, oak lower only, oak upper only); Part C: each non-none door option on one side with stone (both cells) on the other side, both orders. Part D: door LOWER half only (facing = placed facing, hinge=left, closed) in the lower cell with stone above it on one side (sides in order left then right), other side air/air, stone/air, air/stone, stone/stone (lower/upper); clicks 0.25,0.5,0.75. Part E: all four neighbour cells air, clicks 0.5 then 0.4999 then 0.5001.
